description: A wooden stool with a floral cushion. The stool has a square base constructed from horizontal and vertical wooden planks, creating an open, slatted design. The wood appears to be painted white. The top of the stool is a cushioned seat covered in a fabric featuring a floral pattern with shades of pink, purple, and green on a white background. The design is simple and rustic, with visible screws holding the wooden components together. The overall appearance is charming and slightly vintage, suitable for adding a touch of comfort and style to a room.
